extraction.task: Resolve Giesta2 Phase7 blockers P7-B01 and P7-B02 by re-extracting explicit IG3500 official option/order codes while forcing candidate claims to existing Phase7 Option Master option_id values only.
extraction.prompt: Read only printed pages g6-g13 and g72-g77, corresponding to PDF pages 150-157 and 216-221, of the verified official LIXIL IG3500 2026-04 entrance-door order material. Extract narrow atomic Evidence Candidates only where the page explicitly prints a LIXIL option/order/product code and the source wording uniquely maps to one existing Giesta2 Phase7 Option Master option_id from the allowed list. Never invent, rename, abbreviate, normalize, or create an option_id. Candidate claims must use exactly '<allowed option_id> official_option_code = <exact source code or exact source template>'. Prefer a LIXIL product/order code over a separately printed supplier/device model such as EK3850W, EK3822B, VL-SVE710KF or VL-SWE710KF. Preserve code templates, color/handing/placeholders and multiple variant codes exactly as printed; if one scalar official_option_code cannot safely represent a variant family, return an issue rather than collapsing it. Existing semantic rows such as PART_OF_CHILD_DOOR, AFTER_SALES_ONLY or AFTER_SALES_STORE must not have their selection scope changed by this evidence job. Do not evaluate G12/G14 High-size compatibility or P7-B03 in this job. Do not approve, adjudicate, mutate or write Authoring Master, Runtime, Registry, Production, Canonical or Drive working Master files.
